description: Get a single order by its ID, including line items (items[].name is the product name at order time), delivery chunks, payment and status. customer_id links the order to its buyer — read the card with get_customer. payment_info.amount is the full amount paid for the order (discounts and delivery included, item addons excluded; refunds do not reduce it). Read the delivery address from delivery_chunks[].delivery_info.address.locality/.address: they always match the chosen delivery method; of the courier_*, pickup_point_* and self_pick_up_* groups only the one matching `method` is returned.

redact.description: Use redact:true when the task does not need personal data (e.g. counting or aggregating orders) — personal fields (name, phone, email, date of birth, delivery address and its parts, notes) are replaced with "[redacted]". Applies to the response only; request bodies are never redacted. Default false.

name: get_order
title: Get order
